en.title: Embedded games share keyboard focus with the page
en.body: Games started with a parent or canvas now receive keyboard input on their focused canvas. Page buttons keep native keyboard activation, and transparent games show the page through the engine-owned holder.

zh.title: 嵌入游戏与页面控件可以顺畅切换焦点
zh.body: 传入 parent 或 canvas 时，画布获得焦点后接收游戏按键。网页按钮保留原生键盘激活，透明游戏可透过引擎创建的容器显示页面背景。
